gloss: the House of Representatives; the lower house

definitions.gloss: the House of Representatives; the lower house (of the Diet)
definitions.explanation: Short for {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}, the lower house of Japan's parliament. The short form is standard in news headlines and reports, where space and speed matter.

examples.japanese: {衆院|しゅういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{衆院選|しゅういんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投票日|とうひょうび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The date of the lower-house election has been set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衆院|しゅういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧し、{参院|さんいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The bill passed the lower house and moved on to deliberation in the upper house.

notes:
A clipped form of ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧, mostly in writing and news broadcasts. Its counterpart is {参院|さんいん}, short for ⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧ (the House of Councillors).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衆院選|しゅういんせん}: lower-house election (general election)
- {衆院|しゅういん}⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧: dissolution of the lower house
- {衆院|しゅういん}⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: member of the House of Representatives
- {衆院|しゅういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧: (of a bill) to pass the lower house
- {衆院|しゅういん}{本会議|ほんかいぎ}: plenary session of the lower house
